about: The large-workspace story, filled in by whoever owns what it measures (files and sync at scale; the resource store's records). The generator makes one workspace of each size and prints its id as its last line; every step then runs at every size, its budget in budgets.json under `large-workspace` by its title. A step is red when its time grows with the workspace instead of with what it touches: when its time at the largest size over its time at the smallest exceeds `growth.allowed`. Once `generator.command` is set, add `"driver": "large-workspace.mjs"` to the story in stories.json and `large-workspace` to t.toml's user-stories matrix.

generator.what: A shell command run in this checkout with the stack's environment (stack.sh env: TILO_API_URL, TILO_API_KEY of the stack's owner) and STORY_SIZE (the size's label) and STORY_SIZE_PARAMS (its params as JSON). It makes a workspace of that size and prints the workspace's id as its last line.

stepShape.command: {"title": "Ada lists a folder of 5,000 files", "command": "tilo ls -w \"$STORY_WORKSPACE\" big-folder"}: timed from start to exit, with STORY_WORKSPACE, STORY_SIZE and the stack's environment
stepShape.module: {"title": "Ada opens the workspace", "module": "large-steps.mjs", "export": "open"}: called with {story, site, workspace, size, person} where person is a recorder person in a fresh browser; resolves when the person sees what the step is for

growth.about: How much a step's time may grow from the smallest size to the largest. The steps here touch the same amount at every size, so their time should not follow the workspace's size.
